statement: Cowork scheduling help documents remote account-file/connector runs, but the same retained article also offers local folders and says local-file/app tasks run locally; the full scheduling taxonomy remains contradictory and unresolved.
quote:
When you create a scheduled task, Claude saves your prompt as the task's instructions and runs them at the cadence you choose. Tasks can search Slack, query files, run web research, generate reports, and more—using any connectors and plugins you've set up in Cowork.
Each scheduled task runs as its own Cowork session. You can review the results when they're ready, just like any other task.
Scheduled tasks run remotely, so they run on their cadence even when your computer is asleep or the Claude Desktop app is closed. Review upcoming and past runs by clicking "Scheduled" in the left sidebar on any surface.
Note: Scheduled tasks use the built-in schedule options and work with your connectors and the files saved to your Claude account. They can't be tied to a folder on your computer.
For Team and Enterprise organizations, admins control Cowork access through the admin toggle. For more details, see Use Claude Cowork on Team and Enterprise plans.
Create a scheduled task
There are two ways to create a scheduled task:
Create with Claude
Click “Scheduled” in the left sidebar to land on the Scheduled tasks page.
Click “New task” in the upper right, then choose "Create with Claude."
This creates a new task auto-filled with a prompt asking Claude to create a scheduled task.
Claude may ask you questions with multiple choice responses before creating the scheduled task.
Once Claude has all the necessary information, it will output the name of the task it’s creating, the schedule it will follow, and what the task actually does.
You can explicitly confirm you want to schedule the task when prompted by Claude by clicking “Schedule":
Claude will create and schedule your task, and it will be added to the Scheduled tasks page.
Set up manually
Click “Scheduled” in the left sidebar to land on the Scheduled tasks page.
Click “New task” in the upper right, then choose “Set up manually.”
In the Create scheduled task modal, enter the following information:
Task name
The prompt describing what your task does
The approval mode
How frequently the task will run (hourly, daily, weekly, on weekdays, or manually)
The model you want to use [optional]
Which folder Claude should work in [optional]
Note: If a scheduled task requires local files or apps, it will only run locally.
